nom: Paula's Choice Calm Rescue & Repair Intensive Moisturizer

avis.titre: Great ONLY if you have an oil to mix in and probably a hydrating toner as well
avis.texte: I have super sensitive skin to the point that moisturizers, even targeted for sensitive skin, burn my face. I have both rosacea and eczema which makes it difficult to find products. This cream has no scent but it also is more thick gel consistency and dries matte...which is the opposite of what dry skin needs. On its own it made my skin feel hydrated for maybe 10 seconds before it felt like the moisture was sucked out of my skin. But it doesn't burn my skin. Luckily, I have the moisture renewal oil (same brand) to add to this. The oil didn't work with my old moisturizer and I didn't want to toss it because of how expensive it is. On a whim, I found it works perfectly with this moisturizer. It takes exactly three drops mixed in to make my skin actually feel hydrated. With that said, I have also found that I have to use quite a bit to cover my face. Normally I can make a 1 oz tube/jar of lotion last a few months, with this, I am barely making it to the one month mark and this is a 2 oz tube! I have to use between a nickel to quarter size amount (PLUS the oil) to cover my face and I use this twice a day. I also bought the face wash and toner from the same line to help with the moisture. The toner helps a lot so if you buy this, you definitely need a moisturizing toner and face oil to go along with it. This product is awful on its own unless maybe you have oily skin. I don't even think normal skin would be hydrated by this. I gave it three stars because it doesn't break me out or

I really love Paula’s Choice moisturizers as someone with sensitive skin. They’re certainly worth the price in that regard… and they’re worth the discomfort. It’s incredibly - incredibly - difficult to get this product out the tube. I would speculate this problem is so apparent because there is so little product in the container. Very soon after purchasing, you’re going to have to squeeze with all of your might and if you’re like me, until you’re shaking, in order to get enough product out of the container. I’m not sure how one would fix this problem though it certainly isn’t a problem I’ve experienced with another product. This is a unique issue for me but this is also the most expensive product I purchase for my skin, and it also comes in the smallest quantity. I don’t think I’d notice this problem if it came in a larger amount because then I wouldn’t be squeezing so hard so quickly after first purchasing. I hope this makes sense to the right people. If you really struggle with strength in your hands, this may not be the best product for you based simply off the design and how much product that design is holding. But if, like me, you have very sensitive skin, it may be worth it. It does make me a bit sad because how long will I be able to use this product? Until it becomes too uncomfortable for my hands to squeeze it out. So I write this review with the hopes that the design and product quantity can change for people like me.

avis.titre: Very good protectant for sensitive skin
avis.texte: This product could be more moisturizing but it is excellent for my Rosacea problem. No breakouts! Probably worth using it with another product on the rest of my face for maximum moisture. Love the scent.

So far I really like this for at night. It’s thick and moisturizing. There is no scent which I like. I thought it would help with redness and irritation, but it hasn’t yet. I think it’s mostly just for dry skin. You don’t need a lot for your whole face so the size will last a while.

Love this lotion! I was a little apprehensive because of other reviews I have read about it not absorbing well, this feels more to me like a skin barrier type lotion -- it doesnt immediately soak in like some do, but it is there to protect at length instead of dissipate. I have been using it for several days and I will definitely continue to buy -- makes my skin very soft and doesn't burn like some lotions do. And no scent! Love it. Its worth the price in my opinion.

I use this in a set with the calm toner, serum and moisturizer. This set of products has been a gamechanger to me and I don't even have rosacea or eczema. I have a tendency to pick at my skin which is worse when it feels irritated from recent exfoliation. I was able to attack the irritation fully with this routine and as a result I no longer absentmindedly pick at my skin and it has healed tremendously. It is great for my moisture barrier, though I find on dry summer days I need a second moisturizer to lock in the calming effect for the entire day. Of the three products I use together, I find that this moisturizer helps the most with an instant reduction in irritation.
The ONLY moisturizer I've found that doesn't break me out or leave me feeling greasy! Pricey but worth it. You only need a tiny amount per application.
Cruelty free is what sold me initially. Its great product. You only need to use a little for full coverage, so it lasts a long time

avis.titre: Fair dry sensitive to ingredients skin
avis.texte: Almost bought every item that fits my needs…I really have become a fan of PC’s and I just learned about them in November— I’m sensitive to ingredients but no major issues except fine lines/redness around nose/discolor around eyes and dryness… — value for money — as long as they don’t go up I’ll be a lifer — moisturizing — yes it’s a nice morning one before makeup no pilling —- — for sensitive skin — yes definitely did not cause any harm … Check one of my pics every item I have bought at the moment
Giving it 3 stars because it’s really small for the price. However, it does leave your face moisturized. I won’t buy again because of the pricing for this small product.
